artworks.title: Forellenweiher (Trout Pond)
artworks.artist: Franz von Stuck
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid cream paper
artworks.description: The image shows a view of a body of water with trees along the water's edge. The brushstrokes are dense and textured, creating shadows and light reflecting on the water. The color palette consists of dark, muted tones with blacks and grays. The water reflects the trees and sky, with darker tones in the foreground and lighter tones in the background.

artworks.title: Houses
artworks.artist: Heinrich Tischler
artworks.medium: drypoint on laid cream paper
artworks.description: The image displays an intricate array of vertical and diagonal lines forming an abstract depiction of a narrow street or alleyway with towering structures on either side. The lines convey the texture and form of buildings, with vertical strokes indicating walls or facades and diagonal and curved lines suggesting rooftops and shadows. The composition creates depth and perspective akin to an urban canyon or clustered cityscape, connecting architectural forms with light and space.

artworks.title: Einsame
artworks.artist: Heinrich Tischler
artworks.medium: etching on laid buff paper
artworks.description: The image displays a series of intricately etched lines forming an array of angular and curved shapes. This abstract composition features patterns that resemble faces hidden within the design, with eyes and mouths discernible amidst the swirling lines. The overlapping lines and shading enhance the abstract nature, guiding the viewer's eye through a maze-like pattern.

artworks.title: Woman at the Water
artworks.artist: Maria Uhden
artworks.medium: woodcut in black on laid buff paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a stylized figure sitting in water surrounded by foliage. The artwork is a black silhouette print on a light background, depicting a simplified human figure with rounded shapes, seated in what appears to be a shallow pool of water, as suggested by the ripples around the legs. The figure is partially enclosed by tall, leafy plants. The drawing embodies a primitive, almost woodcut-like quality, as seen in the thick, bold lines and abstract representation of the scene. The composition is balanced, with the natural setting providing a serene backdrop to the central figure.

artworks.title: Birches
artworks.artist: Lesser Ury
artworks.medium: lithograph on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a large tree viewed from a lower angle, focusing on its sprawling branches. The background shows a row of smaller trees or shrubs below the main tree's silhouette. The artwork utilizes a textured style resembling charcoal or heavy graphite strokes, creating depth. The color scheme is predominantly black and gray with light highlights, emphasizing contrast and details. The sky above is depicted with a stippled technique, complementing the central tree's prominence in the scene.

artworks.title: On the Floor of the Barn
artworks.artist: Lesser Ury
artworks.medium: drypoint on laid buff paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person holding a long-handled tool, likely a rake, with both hands. They are leaning slightly forward, face down and partially covered by a hat. The person is wearing a long-sleeved shirt, rolled-up sleeves, and dark trousers. The background is heavily shaded, creating depth around the figure in the foreground.

artworks.title: A Woman Carrying a Bundle of Sticks
artworks.artist: Heinrich Zille
artworks.medium: etching and soft-ground etching in brown on wove cream paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person walking along a path. They are hunched over, carrying a large bundle on their back, and using a walking stick with their right hand. The person is wearing a long, dark garment that reaches their feet and simple shoes. In the background, there is a natural landscape with vegetation, including a bush or small tree. The horizon line shows fields under a wide sky, suggesting a rural or wilderness setting.

artworks.title: Moses and the Brazen Serpent
artworks.artist: Boëtius Adams Bolswert, after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 47.5 × 61.5 cm (18 11/16 × 24 3/16 in.) (trimmed to plate mark)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene. The image depicts a group of individuals in a chaotic tangle of movement and emotion. In the foreground, several figures appear to be suffering, some laying on the ground while one figure attempts to cradle another. In the midst of the chaos, two central standing figures hold a staff with a serpent entwined around it, drawing attention toward the upper right of the image. The sky above is filled with serpents among turbulent clouds. The use of light and shadow creates depth and highlights the expressions of despair and hope among the individuals portrayed.

artworks.title: The Disciples on the Way to Emmaus
artworks.artist: Nicolaes de Bruyn, after Gillis van Coninxloo III
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a black and white etching showcasing a vast landscape. It features cliffs and mountains with a castle-like structure in the distance. The detailed etching shows foliage with tree trunks, a winding path, figures walking, a village, and a body of water. The composition is rich in textures and intricate details, creating a serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Banquet of the Gods at the Wedding of Peleus and Thetis
artworks.artist: Jacques de Gheyn II, after Crispen van den Broecke
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 33.1 x 48.3 cm (13 1/16 x 19 in.) (trimmed within plate mark)
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people seated around a table. They are depicted in classical attire and various positions, some interacting with the feast and holding different objects. A central figure is playing a lyre. Two cherubs are hovering above the table, and there are detailed peacock and eagle figures in the scene. The background features swirling clouds.

artworks.title: The Entombment
artworks.artist: Battista Angolo del Moro
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a group of figures surrounding a central figure lying down. The figures have detailed facial features, hair, and beards, with some wearing head coverings and others having long hair or beards. The group includes men and women wearing long robes and head coverings. The figures are in solemn positions, appearing to support or mourn the central individual. The background features a roughly textured surface with foliage above, giving the impression of a cave or rocky setting.

artworks.title: Return from the Flight into Egypt
artworks.artist: Jacques de Gheyn II, after Karel van Mander I
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a procession of angels near ancient ruins. The scene features a group of winged figures, including cherubs and angelic figures, some playing musical instruments such as a harp. The setting is a landscape with old stone structures with arches covered in plants. In the background, there are hills and a distant cityscape. Some angels are leading an animal, while others are engaged in diverse activities. The overall tone is celebratory and lively, with the angels moving gracefully through the ruins.

artworks.title: Christ on the Mount of Olives
artworks.artist: John Baptist Jackson, after Jacopo Bassano
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut from four blocks, printed in buff, brown, gray, and dark brown on laid paper [proof impression without final gray]?
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing of a supernatural scene set in a rocky landscape. A luminous winged figure is depicted in the upper left corner, emitting bright light onto a kneeling figure below. The surrounding terrain includes grassy plants and rocks, with sleeping figures in the foreground. In the distance, a small village or castle is visible under a slightly clouded sky. The overall atmosphere of the artwork is mysterious and spiritual.

artworks.title: Christ on the Mount of Olives
artworks.artist: John Baptist Jackson
artworks.medium: woodcut printed in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an angel descending with light beams, illuminating a figure in prayer. Other figures are resting on the ground. In the distance, a city or village is seen with a tall building; the sky is dark. The style features strong black and white strokes, creating vivid contours. The color scheme is sepia tones with white detailing, resembling an etching or woodblock print.

artworks.title: Christ on the Mount of Olives
artworks.artist: John Baptist Jackson, after Jacopo Bassano
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed from four blocks in buff, medium brown, grey and dark brown on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a nocturnal landscape scene. The scene shows a celestial being interacting with a kneeling figure in a night-time landscape with rocky outcrops and distant architectural structures. The celestial being emits light, standing out in the darkness. The composition emphasizes contrasts between light and shadow using chiaroscuro techniques. The night sky has clouds, and there are spectators, trees, and vegetation in the landscape.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion (left panel)
artworks.artist: John Baptist Jackson, after Jacopo Tintoretto
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut from four blocks, printed in buff, brown, gray, and reddish brown on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical scene with horses and figures engaged in various activities. In the foreground, several muscular figures are performing laborious tasks with tools and wooden structures around. In the mid-ground, horses and figures engaged in travel are present. The scene has a dynamic flow with vividly captured gestures and movements, showing busyness and interaction. The background includes a landscape with trees and a fortified structure or ancient city. The drawing uses a limited color palette with a sepia tone.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion (Left Panel)
artworks.artist: John Baptist Jackson, after Jacopo Tintoretto
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed from four blocks in buff, light brown, gray, and red brown on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with horses and construction work. In the lower part of the image, individuals are depicted engaging in construction or manual labor activities. Tools and materials are scattered around them. Above and to the left, there is a group of figures mounted on horses. Some appear to be conversing. The background includes architectural structures and trees, with a castle or fortress on a hill. The scene conveys a sense of different societal roles and actions coming together during a historical event or significant construction endeavor.

artworks.title: Descent from the Cross
artworks.artist: John Baptist Jackson, after Rembrandt van Rijn
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed from four blocks in yellow, gray, and two shades of brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of people gathered at the base of a hill with three crosses. The central cross features a man crucified on it, with outstretched arms and head slightly bowed. The people below are dressed in historical attire, with some standing and others kneeling or bending over a figure wrapped in cloth. In the background, a cityscape with towers and buildings is visible, under an overcast sky with swirling cloud formations.

artworks.title: Dives and Lazarus (Left Panel)
artworks.artist: John Baptist Jackson, after Jacopo Bassano
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed from four blocks in buff,brown, and two shades of gray on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: image: 55.5 x 37.5 cm (21 7/8 x 14 3/4 in.) cut within image
artworks.description: The image features a group of people around a table under an archway, with large trees and a mountainous landscape in the background. Additional elements include a hanging skinned animal, a basket with fish, a strainer, and a rabbit. The color palette is mainly brown, beige, and white.

artworks.title: The Finding of Moses
artworks.artist: John Baptist Jackson, after Veronese
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed from four blocks in buff, brown, and two shades of gray on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a group of people in an outdoor setting. Most of the figures are shown fully or from the waist up. One person is kneeling on the ground, holding an infant wrapped in a cloth. Several other individuals are positioned nearby, some standing and one appearing to sit. All the figures wear elaborate clothing, indicative of historical or ceremonial attire. Some figures wear headpieces, and one person, likely a central figure, wears a crown. Another figure holds a staff or scepter. The background features tall trees with lush foliage and a scenic view of a city, with structures like arches and pyramids visible in the distance, under a cloudy sky. The image captures a detailed moment of interaction among the figures, suggesting a narrative.

artworks.title: Massacre of the Innocents
artworks.artist: John Baptist Jackson, after Jacopo Tintoretto
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut from four blocks in buff, gray, and two shades of brown on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a historical massacre. The composition shows a chaotic and dramatic scene filled with intense actions, set in an urban environment. Many human figures are engaged in various poses suggesting violence and despair. In the foreground and central area, figures are intertwined, with some in the act of attacking or defending themselves, while others appear to be lamenting or succumbing. The background contains architectural structures and faint horizon lines. The artwork uses a monochromatic color palette.

artworks.title: Melchisedech Blessing Abraham
artworks.artist: John Baptist Jackson, after Francesco Bassano II
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed from four blocks in buff, gray, and two shades of brown on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene depicting a historical or religious meeting. The image illustrates a gathering where two elder figures in robes are greeting each other, while several others stand and sit around them. The gathering appears to take place outdoors, with tents and a throng of livestock like horses and sheep visible in the background. To the right, a table is set with lit candles and some offerings or objects on it. The presence of animals, such as dogs lying peacefully in the foreground and the detailed vegetation, create a serene rural atmosphere. The composition combines elements of nature, camaraderie, and possibly ritualistic or important social interaction.

artworks.title: Mystic Marriage of St. Catherine
artworks.artist: John Baptist Jackson, after Veronese
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed from four blocks on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features multiple figures in a religious and ornate scene. A seated woman holds a child at the center, surrounded by other individuals in various positions. Among them is a figure wearing a crown and elaborate robe. All figures wear flowing garments, and two figures in the lower left read from a book while a musical instrument rests nearby. Winged beings or angels are seen above, with one playing a lute-like instrument. The background consists of billowing clouds, creating a heavenly ambiance. The artwork is highly detailed, evoking a sense of grandeur and divinity.

artworks.title: Mystic Marriage of Saint Catherine
artworks.artist: John Baptist Jackson
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed in tones of gray from four blocks on laid paper
artworks.description: This is an elaborate painting depicting a scene featuring angels and clouds enveloping a central focal point. The composition includes various figures, some with angelic characteristics, wearing flowing garments. They are gathered around an ornate architectural structure, including a draped Corinthian column. Above them, the sky is filled with cherubs and angels among clouds. The figures in the foreground are engaged, with some playing musical instruments and others interacting harmoniously. The painting is in the style of Paulo Veronese, known for grand compositions, elegant figures, and vibrant use of space and form, creating a celestial and theatrical display.
